Goal: Win the court case.

2 options: Prewritten, Custom

Game Loop:

1. People write out court cases and answer to the case (guilty/not guilty)
2. Everyone votes for which court cases to do. Maybe - (If prewritten, they can choose category)
3. 1 Judge is selected from the people and everyone else is a lawyer and knows the truth but isn't divided into Prosecutors and Defendants yet
4. Either: Prewritten evidence, or the people write out the evidence beforehand without revealing if the evidence is real or fake.
5. Lawyers are split into Prosecutor Team, Defendant Team
6. Evidence is split into team piles evenly between each team
7. The prosecutor begins making their argument, 15 mins total trial time
8. People send in motions
   1. Evidence motions (base) (300 characters)
      1. Motion to bring forward evidence: select an evidence from your team's evidence pile and send it to court
      2. Motion to suppress: select an evidence currently in the court and ask the judge to strike it down based on a provided argument
   2. End of phase motions (slowest)
      1. Motion for Summary Judgement
      2. Motion to Complete Explanation
   3. Objections (faster than normal motions)
      1. Objection on the basis of Illegal Communication
      2. Objection on the basis of Poor Logic
   4. Sending in notes, different vehicles (base)
      1. For each character above 10, risk factor +1% (stacks w\ car)
   5. Vehicle
      1. Pick body at start
      2. When destroyed, changes terrain and car parts rearranged into obstacles
      3. Car bodies
         1. Premade
         2. Different base risk factors
         3. Notes increase risk
      4. Wheels
         1. Draw wheels at any time
         2. They just spin
9. After Motion to Complete Explanation, switch speaking teams
10. Once timer ends, or Motion for Summary Judgement, Judge makes guilty or not guilty verdict
11. Winners are determined
